news.title: Filmcity Media Limited Announces Resignation of Mohit Jain as Executive Director, Effective March 11, 2026
news.body: Filmcity Media Limited at its Board of Directors meeting held on March 13, 2026 took note the Resignation Mr. Mohit Jain (DIN: 09684465) from the post of Executive Director with effect from March 11, 2026.

news.title: Filmcity Media Limited Announces Chief Financial Officer Changes
news.body: Filmcity Media Limited at its Board of Directors meeting held on March 13, 2026 took note the Resignation Mr. Mohit Jain (DIN: 09684465) from the post of Chief Financial Officer with effect from March 11, 2026. The company also announced that based on the recommendation of the Audit Committee and Nomination and Remuneration Committee considered and unanimously approved the appointment of Ms. Kirti Vishnu Tiwari (DIN: 09686224) as Chief Financial Officer of the Company effective March 12, 2026, in addition to her existing responsibilities as Executive Director & CEO, and She shall be designated as Executive Director, CEO & Chief Financial Officer, of the Company, being a Key Managerial Personnel of the Company.

news.title: Filmcity Media Limited announced that it expects to receive INR 19 million in funding from PMC Fincorp Limited, EPS Finvest Pvt Limited
news.body: Filmcity Media Limited announced a private placement of Equity Shares of the company for gross proceeds of INR 19,000,000 on March 13, 2026. The transaction involves participation from new investor PMC Fincorp Limited for INR 7,000,000 and EPS Fin-Vest Private Limited for INR 2,500,000 and individual investor Puneet Arora for INR 9,500,000. The transaction has been approved by Board of Directors of the company on preferential basis. The provisions of Chapter V of the SEBI ICDR Regulations, the ‘Relevant Date’ for the purpose of determining the minimum issue price of Equity Shares proposed to be allotted to the above mentioned allottees shall be Monday, March 16, 2026 and thus, the issue price shall be determined in a meeting of the Board or the preferential issue committee on the said date

news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 9.0% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months (9.0% average weekly change). Revenue is less than US$1m. Market cap is less than US$10m (₹67.6m market cap, or US$742.7k)
